long_biography.plain_text:
Winning the Admiral's Cup for Germany in 1973 made Albert Büll a prominent figure in international offshore sailing. The Hamburg entrepreneur applied the same long-term organisation to B&L Group, the real-estate business he co-founded, while continuing to compete internationally for more than a decade.

As B&L matured, Büll moved into advisory and investment roles. He joined the group's advisory board and has led ABACON Capital, the family investment platform, across property, energy, mobility and growth companies. A board role at the Büll Family Foundation for Youth added a philanthropic institution to the structures created around his business.
